title: Why do animals have such different lifespans? - Joao Pedro de Magalhaes
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】為什麼動物的壽命如此不同？ ——若昂·佩德羅·德·馬加良斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: For the microscopic lab worm, C. elegans life equates to just a few short weeks on Earth.
cues.en: For the microscopic lab worm, C. elegans life equates to just a few short weeks on Earth.
cues.zh: 對於顯微鏡下的秀麗隱桿腺蟲而言 一生不過短短幾週的時間 相對而言，烏龜可以活超過100年

cues.text: Compare that with the tortoise, which can age to more than 100 years.
cues.en: Compare that with the tortoise, which can age to more than 100 years.
cues.zh: 相對而言，烏龜可以活超過100年 中、小型鼠的壽命則大約為4年

cues.text: Mice and rats reach the end of their lives after just four years,
cues.en: Mice and rats reach the end of their lives after just four years,
cues.zh: 中、小型鼠的壽命則大約為4年 而地球上最長壽的哺乳類是弓頭鯨

cues.text: while for the bowhead whale, Earth's longest-lived mammal,
cues.en: while for the bowhead whale, Earth's longest-lived mammal,
cues.zh: 而地球上最長壽的哺乳類是弓頭鯨 壽命超過200歲

cues.text: death can come after 200.
cues.en: death can come after 200.
cues.zh: 壽命超過200歲 大多數動物和大部分生物一樣

cues.text: Like most living things, the vast majority of animals gradually degenerate after reaching sexual maturity
cues.en: Like most living things, the vast majority of animals gradually degenerate after reaching sexual maturity
cues.zh: 大多數動物和大部分生物一樣 在性成熟後身體便開始退化 這個過程稱為老化

cues.text: in the process known as aging.
cues.en: in the process known as aging.
cues.zh: 這個過程稱為老化 但老化到底是什麼？

cues.text: But what does it really mean to age?
cues.en: But what does it really mean to age?
cues.zh: 但老化到底是什麼？ 這過程的成因十分繁雜

cues.text: The drivers behind this process are varied and complicated,
cues.en: The drivers behind this process are varied and complicated,
cues.zh: 這過程的成因十分繁雜 簡單來說，細胞死亡和功能失常 最終會導致老化

cues.text: but aging is ultimately caused by cell death and dysfunction.
cues.en: but aging is ultimately caused by cell death and dysfunction.
cues.zh: 簡單來說，細胞死亡和功能失常 最終會導致老化 年輕時，我們的細胞會不斷再生

cues.text: When we're young, we constantly regenerate cells in order to replace dead and dying ones.
cues.en: When we're young, we constantly regenerate cells in order to replace dead and dying ones.
cues.zh: 年輕時，我們的細胞會不斷再生 取代已死亡及凋零的細胞 隨著年紀增長，再生速度會愈來愈慢

cues.text: But as we age, this process slows down.
cues.en: But as we age, this process slows down.
cues.zh: 隨著年紀增長，再生速度會愈來愈慢 而且老舊細胞的功能不如新細胞好

cues.text: In addition, older cells don't perform their functions as well as young ones.
cues.en: In addition, older cells don't perform their functions as well as young ones.
cues.zh: 而且老舊細胞的功能不如新細胞好 這使得我們的身體開始衰退

cues.text: That makes our bodies go into a decline, which eventually results in disease and death.
cues.en: That makes our bodies go into a decline, which eventually results in disease and death.
cues.zh: 這使得我們的身體開始衰退 最終導致疾病與死亡

cues.text: But if that's consistently true, why the huge variance in aging patterns and lifespan within the animal kingdom?
cues.en: But if that's consistently true, why the huge variance in aging patterns and lifespan within the animal kingdom?
cues.zh: 若這現象是所有生物的共通點 為何不同動物的老化機制 和壽命會差這麼多？ 有幾種因素

cues.text: The answer lies in several factors, including environment
cues.en: The answer lies in several factors, including environment
cues.zh: 有幾種因素 像是環境 和體型

cues.text: and body size.
cues.en: and body size.
cues.zh: 和體型 在演化上都會大幅影響動物適應狀況

cues.text: These can place powerful evolutionary pressures on animals to adapt,
cues.en: These can place powerful evolutionary pressures on animals to adapt,
cues.zh: 在演化上都會大幅影響動物適應狀況 進一步使不同動物有不同的老化過程

cues.text: which in turn makes the aging process different across species.
cues.en: which in turn makes the aging process different across species.
cues.zh: 進一步使不同動物有不同的老化過程 在大西洋和北極海的深處

cues.text: Consider the cold depths of the Atlantic and Arctic Seas,
cues.en: Consider the cold depths of the Atlantic and Arctic Seas,
cues.zh: 在大西洋和北極海的深處 格陵蘭鯊可以活超過400年

cues.text: where Greenland sharks can live to over 400 years, and the Arctic clam known as the quahog can live up to 500.
cues.en: where Greenland sharks can live to over 400 years, and the Arctic clam known as the quahog can live up to 500.
cues.zh: 格陵蘭鯊可以活超過400年 而北極貝的壽命長達500年 在這些海洋古生物中，最令人印象深刻的

cues.text: Perhaps the most impressive of these ocean-dwelling ancients is the Antarctic glass sponge,
cues.en: Perhaps the most impressive of these ocean-dwelling ancients is the Antarctic glass sponge,
cues.zh: 在這些海洋古生物中，最令人印象深刻的 或許是南極玻璃海綿 牠們可以在嚴寒的水中生存超過一萬年

cues.text: which can survive over 10,000 years in frigid waters.
cues.en: which can survive over 10,000 years in frigid waters.
cues.zh: 牠們可以在嚴寒的水中生存超過一萬年 在如此寒冷的環境， 心跳和代謝率都會下降

cues.text: In cold environments like these, heartbeats and metabolic rates slow down.
cues.en: In cold environments like these, heartbeats and metabolic rates slow down.
cues.zh: 在如此寒冷的環境， 心跳和代謝率都會下降 研究員推論這會導致老化過程趨緩

cues.text: Researchers theorize that this also causes a slowing of the aging process.
cues.en: Researchers theorize that this also causes a slowing of the aging process.
cues.zh: 研究員推論這會導致老化過程趨緩 這麼看來，環境的確會影響壽命長短

cues.text: In this way, the environment shapes longevity.
cues.en: In this way, the environment shapes longevity.
cues.zh: 這麼看來，環境的確會影響壽命長短 而當談到體型時，大部分的狀況是

cues.text: When it comes to size, it's often, but not always, the case that larger species have a longer lifespan than smaller ones.
cues.en: When it comes to size, it's often, but not always, the case that larger species have a longer lifespan than smaller ones.
cues.zh: 而當談到體型時，大部分的狀況是 體型較大的生物壽命也比較長 例如大象或鯨魚的壽命

cues.text: For instance, an elephant or whale will live much longer than a mouse, rat, or vole,
cues.en: For instance, an elephant or whale will live much longer than a mouse, rat, or vole,
cues.zh: 例如大象或鯨魚的壽命 就比小老鼠、中型鼠或田鼠的壽命長很多 而老鼠的壽命同樣也比蒼蠅和小蟲長很多

cues.text: which in turn have years on flies and worms.
cues.en: which in turn have years on flies and worms.
cues.zh: 而老鼠的壽命同樣也比蒼蠅和小蟲長很多 像小蟲和蒼蠅這類的小動物

cues.text: Some small animals, like worms and flies, are also limited by the mechanics of their cell division.
cues.en: Some small animals, like worms and flies, are also limited by the mechanics of their cell division.
cues.zh: 像小蟲和蒼蠅這類的小動物 也受限於細胞分裂的機制 牠們的細胞無法分裂， 遭破壞時也無可替換

cues.text: They're mostly made up of cells that can't divide and be replaced when damaged,
cues.en: They're mostly made up of cells that can't divide and be replaced when damaged,
cues.zh: 牠們的細胞無法分裂， 遭破壞時也無可替換 所以生命很快就會終止

cues.text: so their bodies expire more quickly.
cues.en: so their bodies expire more quickly.
cues.zh: 所以生命很快就會終止 對動物而言，體型是強大的演化驅動力

cues.text: And size is a powerful evolutionary driver in animals.
cues.en: And size is a powerful evolutionary driver in animals.
cues.zh: 對動物而言，體型是強大的演化驅動力 體型較小的生物容易受到掠食者攻擊

cues.text: Smaller creatures are more prone to predators.
cues.en: Smaller creatures are more prone to predators.
cues.zh: 體型較小的生物容易受到掠食者攻擊

cues.text: A mouse, for instance, can hardly expect to survive more than a year in the wild.
cues.en: A mouse, for instance, can hardly expect to survive more than a year in the wild.
cues.zh: 例如小老鼠就很難在荒野活過一年 因此，老鼠得加快成長與繁殖的速度

cues.text: So, it has evolved to grow and reproduce more rapidly,
cues.en: So, it has evolved to grow and reproduce more rapidly,
cues.zh: 因此，老鼠得加快成長與繁殖的速度

cues.text: like an evolutionary defense mechanism against its shorter lifespan.
cues.en: like an evolutionary defense mechanism against its shorter lifespan.
cues.zh: 這就是演化的防衛機制 與短壽命相抗衡後的結果 相對地，大型動物較擅於防禦掠食者

cues.text: Larger animals, by contrast, are better at fending off predators,
cues.en: Larger animals, by contrast, are better at fending off predators,
cues.zh: 相對地，大型動物較擅於防禦掠食者 所以牠們有充分時間可以長大

cues.text: and so they have the luxury of time to grow to large sizes and reproduce multiple times during their lives.
cues.en: and so they have the luxury of time to grow to large sizes and reproduce multiple times during their lives.
cues.zh: 所以牠們有充分時間可以長大 而且一生可以繁殖很多次

cues.text: Exceptions to the size rule include bats, birds, moles, and turtles,
cues.en: Exceptions to the size rule include bats, birds, moles, and turtles,
cues.zh: 但還是有例外，像蝙蝠、 鳥類、鼴鼠和海龜 不過這些動物都有各自的方式

cues.text: but in each case, these animals have other adaptations that allow them to escape predators.
cues.en: but in each case, these animals have other adaptations that allow them to escape predators.
cues.zh: 不過這些動物都有各自的方式 可以逃過掠食者的捕捉 有些動物在體型、棲地等特性上

cues.text: But there are still cases where animals with similar defining features,
cues.en: But there are still cases where animals with similar defining features,
cues.zh: 有些動物在體型、棲地等特性上

cues.text: like size and habitat, age at completely different rates.
cues.en: like size and habitat, age at completely different rates.
cues.zh: 有些動物在體型、棲地等特性上 都很相似 但老化速度卻完全不同 在這些狀況下，基因差異

cues.text: In these cases, genetic differences, like how each organism's cells respond to threats,
cues.en: In these cases, genetic differences, like how each organism's cells respond to threats,
cues.zh: 在這些狀況下，基因差異 例如細胞因應威脅方式的不同 才能夠解釋壽命長短的差異

cues.text: often account for the discrepancies in longevity.
cues.en: often account for the discrepancies in longevity.
cues.zh: 才能夠解釋壽命長短的差異 綜合所有因素的作用

cues.text: So it's the combination of all these factors playing out to differing degrees in different animals
cues.en: So it's the combination of all these factors playing out to differing degrees in different animals
cues.zh: 綜合所有因素的作用 造成動物之間的差異

cues.text: that explains the variability we see in the animal kingdom.
cues.en: that explains the variability we see in the animal kingdom.
cues.zh: 造成動物之間的差異 這也解釋了動物王國裡的變異性 那我們人類呢

cues.text: So what about us?
cues.en: So what about us?
cues.zh: 那我們人類呢 人類目前平均壽命為71歲

cues.text: Humans currently have an average life expectancy of 71 years,
cues.en: Humans currently have an average life expectancy of 71 years,
cues.zh: 人類目前平均壽命為71歲 這表示我們和地球最長壽的居民 還差一大截！

cues.text: meaning that we're not even close to being the longest living inhabitants on Earth.
cues.en: meaning that we're not even close to being the longest living inhabitants on Earth.
cues.zh: 這表示我們和地球最長壽的居民 還差一大截！ 但我們擅於延長壽命

cues.text: But we are very good at increasing our life expectancy.
cues.en: But we are very good at increasing our life expectancy.
cues.zh: 但我們擅於延長壽命 20世紀初期，人類平均只能活到50歲

cues.text: In the early 1900s, humans only lived an average of 50 years.
cues.en: In the early 1900s, humans only lived an average of 50 years.
cues.zh: 20世紀初期，人類平均只能活到50歲 從那時起，我們漸漸學會控制

cues.text: Since then, we've learned to adapt by managing many of the factors
cues.en: Since then, we've learned to adapt by managing many of the factors
cues.zh: 從那時起，我們漸漸學會控制 一些會導致死亡的因素

cues.text: that cause deaths, like environmental exposure and nutrition.
cues.en: that cause deaths, like environmental exposure and nutrition.
cues.zh: 一些會導致死亡的因素 例如環境和營養

cues.text: This, and other increases in life expectancy make us possibly the only species on Earth
cues.en: This, and other increases in life expectancy make us possibly the only species on Earth
cues.zh: 種種延長壽命的方式 也許能讓我們成為地球上唯一一種

cues.text: to take control over our natural fate.
cues.en: to take control over our natural fate.
cues.zh: 也許能讓我們成為地球上唯一一種 可以主宰自己命運的生物
